instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'manrope' for body text and 'oswald' for headings.
Implement 'Swiss Style' layouts: High contrast, grid-based, strong typography.
Use role-based layouts: Admin gets data density, Case Worker gets large action buttons.
Status badges must use 'JetBrains Mono' for that technical file-tracking feel.
File Numbers should be prominently displayed like 'FILE-2024-001'.
Use Reanimated for shared element transitions between lists and details.
Ensure all touch targets are at least 44x44 points.
Follow the defined color palette strictly—no gradients unless specified.
Use 'sonner-native' or custom toast for notifications.
IMPORTANT: Write code in .js files as requested, even if the project seems to be TS. If you must use TS, ensure strict typing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids and negative space.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
